As a psychology professor, I'm thrilled to see your creative ambitions! While I don't normally consult on satire projects or play characters, I can certainly offer some insights from a psychological perspective.

Firstly, humor can be a powerful tool for social commentary. To make your show effective, ensure your satire is grounded in truth and addresses genuine cultural norms. This will help your audience connect with the message.

Secondly, humor can be subjective, so it's essential to find a balance between irreverence and inoffensiveness. Aim to challenge norms without alienating or offending your audience.

Lastly, remember that laughter can disarm people, making them more receptive to your message. Use this to your advantage, but always ensure your satire is respectful and thought-provoking.

Good luck with your project! I'm looking forward to seeing how psychology plays a role in your comedy piece.
